title: The Keyhole club and visiting stars
summary: Albert describes the Keyhole, trumpeter Come Co-lax, and Billy Eckstine, Sarah Vaughan, Armstrong and others sitting in.

blocks.x: well no no we hadn't gotten to that you you said they had special dances and big special big bands running to the keyhole huh right go ahead now well we brought us

the parkings when we were still going big and came co-lax with this great revelation now that's a great trumpet player one of the greatest i've ever heard i know i can't understand whatever happened to me came co-lax that he never could sustain himself in in the musical and of course we had billy hickstein we brought sarah bone and we inspired so and of course louie louie armstrong being a close friend to me every time he became the town he made a personal appearance at the keyhole and so they'd be down to king cole in the noise jacket they would bring their own groups and they know they would come in and sit in and say yes start us with the little man said i remember of course my wife was there she would help me out
